hook.say: Deserts, ancient cities and the tallest tower on Earth. Name these five Middle Eastern countries by shape!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Saudi Arabia covers about 80% of the Arabian Peninsula.
questions.sayAnswer: Saudi Arabia! It covers about 80 percent of the Arabian Peninsula.

questions.fact: Oman: its capital, Muscat, lies on the Gulf of Oman.
questions.sayAnswer: Oman! Its capital, Muscat, lies on the Gulf of Oman.

questions.fact: Yemen: the Old City of Sana'a has been a World Heritage Site since 1986.
questions.sayAnswer: Yemen! The Old City of Sanaa has been a World Heritage Site since 1986.

questions.fact: United Arab Emirates: home to the Burj Khalifa, the tallest building on Earth.
questions.sayAnswer: The United Arab Emirates! Home to the Burj Khalifa, the tallest building on Earth.

questions.fact: Jordan: home to Petra, the Rose City carved into sandstone cliffs.
questions.sayAnswer: Jordan! Home to Petra, the Rose City carved into sandstone cliffs.
